sections.changelog:
0.16.4

  • Improved Rent Manager availability by using lease move-in, notice, and expected move-out data instead of relying on current vacancy alone.
  • Prevented units with future leases from appearing available, while allowing occupied units on notice to show their expected future availability.
  • Rolled unit availability up to floorplans and properties whenever at least one related unit has current or future availability.
  • Updated base rent calculations to favor pricing applicable to a unit's availability date and exclude expired historical rents when current or future pricing is available.
  • Hardened Rent Manager syncing against incomplete or failed responses and improved diagnostic preservation for troubleshooting.
